notes.title: Let'em be Giant!
notes.content: [p]Many fixes and the re-implementation of giant trees in the green hills biome (more Beautiful than ever).[/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]More hints added to the tutorial (Hope it helps to new players).[/p][/*][*][p]The message when learning stats/spells has been highlighted so it would be harded to miss it out.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved slope behaviour of Levi.[/p][/*][*][p]A carryable object bug fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Horses has better behaviour.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera behaviour improved to feel more responsive.[/p][/*][*][p]And a lot of little adjustments to the world.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649314/d6a21782c406e96a7354ebd4811efee67f8d1349.png"][/img]  [/p]
